items.title: Cline Desktop App
items.name: Cline Desktop App
items.summary: An open-source app for open-weight models
items.description: Cline Desktop gives you an open-source workspace to put your favourite model to work - run multiple agent sessions, automate recurring tasks, extend their capabilities through Cline’s Marketplace, and continue work from agents like Claude Code and Codex. Choose the models and providers that work best for you, while Cline’s agent harness, optimized for open-weight models, powers the work behind them. All without being tied to a closed ecosystem.
top_comments:
👋 Hey Product Hunt - I’m Saoud, founder of Cline.


What we’re launching today 🚀

Cline started as a VS Code extension and is now used by more than 11 million developers. Today, we’re launching Cline Desktop, an early version of our open source app for open weight models.

It brings the same Cline agent harness into a dedicated workspace where you can run agents in parallel, automate recurring work, extend what Cline can do through the Marketplace, and import tasks from other coding agents to keep going in Cline.

Cline Desktop is available on Mac, with Windows in beta.


👉 Download Cline Desktop: https://cline.bot/desktop


Why Cline Desktop❓

As we started delegating more work to agents ourselves, we found that keeping track of multiple agents, tasks, and context gets difficult pretty quickly.

The IDE extension and CLI work well when you’re actively working alongside an agent. But as you delegate more work, we think there should be a better place to manage those tasks together.

We also want Cline to complement the tools you already use. We jump between models and agents too, so being able to import a task from Claude Code or Codex and continue it in Cline was important to us.

What you can do with Cline Desktop ✨

🔷 Choose the models and providers that work best for you, including 300+ models through Cline, open-weight models through ClinePass, local models, or your own API keys
🔷 Import tasks from Claude Code, Codex, and other supported agents and continue with the existing context
🔷 Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, research, and other work
🔷 Schedule recurring tasks like PR reviews, repo checks, and documentation updates
🔷 Discover and manage plugins, MCP servers, and skills through Cline’s Marketplace
🔷 Use web search and voice input to bring in outside context and give longer instructions
🔷 You can also start a task in Cline CLI or VS Code extension and pick it up again in the Desktop app.


Where we’re headed ✨

This is still an early version, and we want to learn how people use agents beyond the IDE and terminal.

We’re excited to share Cline Desktop with the Product Hunt community and would love your feedback on what works, what feels rough, and what you’d like us to build next.
This could be a great fit for repository maintenance and dependency checks, test coverage, small refactors, documentation updates, and similar tasks that tend to accumulate.

items.title: Cline Desktop App
items.name: Cline Desktop App
items.summary: An open-source app for open-weight models
items.description: Cline Desktop gives you an open-source workspace to put your favourite model to work - run multiple agent sessions, automate recurring tasks, extend their capabilities through Cline’s Marketplace, and continue work from agents like Claude Code and Codex. Choose the models and providers that work best for you, while Cline’s agent harness, optimized for open-weight models, powers the work behind them. All without being tied to a closed ecosystem.
top_comments:
👋 Hey Product Hunt - I’m Saoud, founder of Cline.


What we’re launching today 🚀

Cline started as a VS Code extension and is now used by more than 11 million developers. Today, we’re launching Cline Desktop, an early version of our open source app for open weight models.

It brings the same Cline agent harness into a dedicated workspace where you can run agents in parallel, automate recurring work, extend what Cline can do through the Marketplace, and import tasks from other coding agents to keep going in Cline.

Cline Desktop is available on Mac, with Windows in beta.


👉 Download Cline Desktop: https://cline.bot/desktop


Why Cline Desktop❓

As we started delegating more work to agents ourselves, we found that keeping track of multiple agents, tasks, and context gets difficult pretty quickly.

The IDE extension and CLI work well when you’re actively working alongside an agent. But as you delegate more work, we think there should be a better place to manage those tasks together.

We also want Cline to complement the tools you already use. We jump between models and agents too, so being able to import a task from Claude Code or Codex and continue it in Cline was important to us.

What you can do with Cline Desktop ✨

🔷 Choose the models and providers that work best for you, including 300+ models through Cline, open-weight models through ClinePass, local models, or your own API keys
🔷 Import tasks from Claude Code, Codex, and other supported agents and continue with the existing context
🔷 Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, research, and other work
🔷 Schedule recurring tasks like PR reviews, repo checks, and documentation updates
🔷 Discover and manage plugins, MCP servers, and skills through Cline’s Marketplace
🔷 Use web search and voice input to bring in outside context and give longer instructions
🔷 You can also start a task in Cline CLI or VS Code extension and pick it up again in the Desktop app.


Where we’re headed ✨

This is still an early version, and we want to learn how people use agents beyond the IDE and terminal.

We’re excited to share Cline Desktop with the Product Hunt community and would love your feedback on what works, what feels rough, and what you’d like us to build next.
This could be a great fit for repository maintenance and dependency checks, test coverage, small refactors, documentation updates, and similar tasks that tend to accumulate.
items.author: [REDACTED] / Renee Huang
items.why: Product Hunt 当前获得 263 票、20 条评论；仍处在近期新品验证窗口；产品形态已经比较完整
items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于以桌面工作台承接复杂任务，把模型能力包装成稳定可交付的软件入口。
items.routing_reason: Cline Desktop 是面向开放权重模型的通用 AI 代理工作台，偏软件工程与底层代理运行环境，虽然提到任务管理和自动化，但并未明显服务某个给定垂直兴趣点的核心任务，不应硬分配到 AI 任务管理或企业自动化。

items.reuse_direction: 最值得借鉴的是把 agent harness 做成桌面客户端来托管开放权重模型的会话与工具调用，让模型接入、任务执行和扩展分发都落在本地，而不是散在网页和服务端。

idea_items.title: AI 面试官
idea_items.need_line: 候选人反复面试被拒后，想知道自己究竟挂在哪一轮、哪句回答被面试官理解出了歧义，而不是只收到一句“回去等通知”。
idea_items.status_line: 目前只能靠知乎经验帖反推信号（如等通知约等于没戏、面试过短说明太差或太好），或用 job-hunt-copilot 这类 Claude Skill 生成定制简历、面试讲稿和模拟面试，都覆盖不到真实问答的复盘。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把单场面试问答逐条留存并做复盘的产品化方向：按轮次与问题标注哪些表述触发了面试官的负面判断，让候选人下次改掉反复失败的那几句话。

idea_items.title: AI 宠物陪伴
idea_items.need_line: 独居者在失去老伴或与亲友断联后，头疼脑热时希望有人搭把手，连续阴雨整日不出门时希望持续获得回应，而不是只得到一次性问答。
idea_items.status_line: 眼下多靠养猫、通宵打游戏、刷手机看电视来填满时间，AI 陪伴侧虽已有 giftia 这类带认知记忆、用 LangGraph 做多 Agent 协作的助手，但讨论仍停留在“能不能陪”这一层。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把陪伴对象做成能记住用户身体状况与作息、在无人开口时主动起话，并承接吃药提醒、就医陪跑这类照护动作的长期在场型产品。

idea_items.title: AI 学习工具
idea_items.need_line: 学生按新课标分科学习时，缺一套能即开即用、又补得上课件讲不到之处的内容与工具，只能自己东拼西凑。
idea_items.status_line: 学生靠自攒的网页小工具分科兜底（知识框架、交互式元素周期表、方程式库），老师用课后自查十分钟 presentation 补课件空白，课件资料则在考研论坛、CSDN 积分下载等搬运渠道流转。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把学生自己的课件、笔记与课堂上讲不全的空白沉淀成一层可自托管的个人知识底座，再让代理在这层底座上做知识点定位、公式情境化解释和复习编排，而不是继续产出彼此孤立、用完即走的盘点型工具。

vendor_news_items.raw_summary: # Generated by Speakeasy CLI ## 2026-09-09 10:25:27 ### API changes Removed (19): - campaigns.create - campaigns.delete - campaigns.fetch - campaigns.fetch_status - campaigns.list - campaigns.list_events - chatcompletionevents.fetch - chatcompletionevents.fetch_similar_events - chatcompletionevents.judge - chatcompletionevents.search - chatcompletionevents.search_ids - connectors.create_or_update_organization_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_user_credentials - connectors.create_or_update_workspace_credentials - datasets.import_from_campaign - datasets.import_from_explorer - fields.fetch_option_counts - fields.fetch_options - fields.list Added (17): - connectors.create_credentials - connectors.share_to_organization - connectors.unshare_from_organization - connectors.update_credentials - evaluations.create_pipeline_config - evaluations.delete_pipeline_config - evaluations.get_pipeline_config - evaluations.list_pipeline_configs - evaluations.update_pipeline_config - serviceaccounts.create - serviceaccounts.delete - serviceaccounts.get - serviceaccounts.list - serviceaccounts.list_assignable_roles - serviceaccounts.list_roles - serviceaccounts.set_roles - serviceaccounts.update ### Breaking changes Connectors - `connectors.create` now takes a single request object, and `connectors.update` a `request_body`. The named arguments (`name`, `description`, `server`, `title`, ...) are no longer accepted. - `Connector` is now a union of `HTTPConnector` and `MCPConnector`, discriminated on `protocol`. Fields that were flat on `Connector` now live on the variant. - `protocol` is required on the create payload. In TypeScript it no longer defaults to `"mcp"`, so it must be passed explicitly. Python still defaults it. Other models - `ExtendedOAuthServerMetadata.authorization_endpoint` is now optional. - `UsageInfoDollarDefs.service_tier` has been removed. - Three fields on `DeploymentWorkerSpecResponse` are now required. ### Fixed - Transcription segment `start` and `end` are now nullable. The API can return null for these, so diarized transcriptions previously failed to parse. ### Changes Based on: - OpenAPI Doc - Speakeasy CLI 1.796.1 (2.933.0) https://github.com/speakeasy-api/speakeasy ### Generated - [python v2.10.0] . ### Releases - [PyPI v2.10.0] https://pypi.org/project/mistralai/2.10.0 - . Publishing Completed

vendor_news_items.title: xAI SDK v1.19.0 发布
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: ## What's Changed * Update README examples to use grok-4.6 by @gyang-xai in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/191 * Set `tool_call_id` when replaying tool outputs via `chat.append(response)` by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/192 * Add quality parameter to image generation and regen protos from xai-proto by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/193 * Add `reference_audios`, `generate_audio`, and 1080p to video generation by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/194 * Set default gRPC User-Agent to XaiSdk/{version} by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/195 * Add image_generation server-side tool by @yanxi0830 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/186 * Prepare to release v1.19.0 of the xAI Python SDK by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/198 ## New Contributors * @yanxi0830 made their first contribution in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/186 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0
vendor_news_items.summary: xAI 发布 Python SDK v1.19.0，新增图像生成 quality 参数与 image_generation 服务端工具，视频生成支持 reference_audios、generate_audio 及 1080p，并为 gRPC 设置默认 User-Agent，README 示例改用 grok-4.6。
impact_points: xAI / Grok 开放新 API / 工具后，开发者可以直接把上游能力接入现有工作流。
watch_items: 关注新 API / 工具是否附带调用限制、权限门槛或额外工程复杂度。

high_potential_items.title: bytedance/deer-flow
high_potential_items.name: deer-flow
high_potential_items.summary: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 跑几小时的长任务，靠子智能体与沙箱记忆
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 可借鉴把沙箱、记忆、工具和子智能体封装成一层长时任务执行外壳，让深度研究、写代码、做播客这类要跑几十分钟到几小时的任务能自己推进到底。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先只做深度研究这一条链路：主智能体拆解问题后派给带沙箱的子智能体去检索，过程与结论写入共享记忆，最后汇总成一份带引用的报告。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 883；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 字节开源的长时程 SuperAgent 框架，覆盖沙箱、记忆、子代理与消息网关，是企业自动化工作流的标杆级项目，今日最值得看。

high_potential_items.title: blader/humanizer
high_potential_items.name: humanizer
high_potential_items.summary: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 给 AI 写的文字去 AI 味
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把“消除 AI 写作痕迹”这类隐性编辑标准写成一份可被 Claude Code、Cursor 等 agent 直接加载的 skill，是写作类工具值得借鉴的分发与复用方式。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版只做一条链路：用户贴入一段 AI 生成的文字，由 agent 按固定的“去 AI 腔”规则清单改写，并直接返回可用的成稿。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 3673；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 去除 AI 写作痕迹的 Agent 技能，属真实可落地的文本处理工具，周增 3.6k 热度验证强，与内容/写作类 AI 应用方向相关。

high_potential_items.title: jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch
high_potential_items.name: hyperresearch
high_potential_items.summary: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: Agent 边查网页边沉淀可检索 wiki
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把 Agent 每次网页调研的结果写进一个持久、可检索的 wiki，而不是留在用完即弃的对话记录里，这个做法适合迁移到需要长期积累资料的研究、情报追踪或竞品监测场景。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先让 Agent 抓取一批网页，抽取成条目写入本地 wiki 并支持关键词检索，验证「调研结果下次能直接搜到」这件事成立。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 1311；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: Agent 驱动的持续研究知识库，把网页研究沉淀为可检索 wiki，属研究型 Agent 产品形态，与知识检索/RAG 方向契合。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是面试失败的原因对候选人始终不可见，而现有工具停留在简历与讲稿生成，尚未闭合“单场面试复盘归因”这个环节。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 候选人多次面试被拒后，需要知道自己具体挂在哪一轮、哪句回答被面试官理解出了歧义，而不是只收到一句“回去等通知”

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前只能靠知乎经验帖反推信号（等通知基本等于没戏、面试时间短要么太差要么太好），GitHub 上 job-hunt-copilot 这类 Claude Skill 也还只覆盖按岗位生成定制简历、面试讲稿和模拟面试。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把单场面试问答逐条留存做复盘的方向——按轮次和问题标注哪些表述触发了面试官的负面判断，让候选人下次能改掉反复失败的那几句话。

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是独居陪伴的真实缺口不在闲聊频次，而在于缺少一个记得住人、会主动出现并接得住照护动作的长期对象。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 独居者在失去老伴或与亲友断联后，需要有人在头疼脑热时搭把手、在连续阴雨整天不出门的日子里持续给出回应，而不是只处理一次性问答

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现在主要靠养猫、通宵打游戏、刷手机看电视来填满时间，AI 陪伴侧的现状证据是 GitHub 上 giftia 这类带认知记忆、用 LangGraph 多 Agent 协作的助手，讨论还停留在“能不能陪”这一层。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把陪伴对象做成能记住用户身体状况与作息、在没人开口时主动起话、并能承接吃药提醒或就医陪跑这类照护动作的长期在场型产品。

interest_sections.title: AI 学习工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是AI学习工具的痛点在"课件讲不全＋资料散落难查"，用户已用大量零散网页工具自救，下一步机会在于能被个人资料喂养、可持续沉淀的自托管学习代理。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是学生靠自攒一批网页即开即用的小工具分科兜底——按新课标重排的知识框架、交互式元素周期表、方程式库，老师端则用"课后自查资料做十分钟presentation"来补课件讲不到的部分，课件与资料靠考研论坛、CSDN积分下载这类搬运渠道流转。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把学生自己的课件、笔记和老师课上讲不全的空白沉淀成一层可自托管的个人知识底座，再让代理在这层底座上做知识点定位、公式情境化解释和复习编排，而不是继续做又一批彼此孤立、吃完即走的盘点型工具。

interest_sections.title: AI 任务管理
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是任务管理的抱怨已从“功能够不够”转向“找到并处理那一条太慢”，而 AI 工具正从外部接管这一步。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是大家主要靠绕行办法：系统侧干脆重启电脑或去命令行敲结束进程，效率工具侧则挑自定义能力强的项目软件（如 PingCode）自己配流程、表单和模板，AI 侧开始用 Feishu-MCP 把飞书文档与任务接进 Cursor、Claude Code 这类编码工具。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把“定位那一条并执行动作”单独抽成一层可被 AI 工具调用的轻量接口，让查询、筛选、终止或指派在一次调用里完成，而不是继续往主界面里叠功能。
